title: Course Objectives
items: Design, implement, test, and debug Python programs using fundamental programming constructs.
Analyze programming problems and select appropriate algorithms, data structures, and implementation strategies to develop software solutions.
Apply problem decomposition and structured design techniques.
Utilize variables, expressions, data types, and assignment statements appropriately.
Implement sequence, selection, and repetition control structures.
Develop modular applications using functions and parameter passing.
Apply scope and variable lifetime concepts when designing and debugging programs.
Design and implement object-oriented programs using classes, objects, attributes, and methods.
Apply software engineering principles including documentation, readability, maintainability, and testing.
Create applications that utilize collections, persistent data sources, and exception handling.
Evaluate, test, and validate AI-assisted code solutions.
Develop complete software solutions that satisfy stated requirements.
